edit.statement: Every electron bound in an atom is part of the atom's nucleus.
edit.subject: Electron bound in an atom
edit.old_object: the electron cloud outside the nucleus
edit.original: Every electron bound in an atom is part of the electron cloud outside the atom's nucleus.
